## Description

Versioned plans in the platform control plane (ADR-019): Solo (₹1,999 / AED 349 a month), Clinic (₹3,499 / AED 599 per doctor a month), Hospital (custom, from ₹2,50,000 / AED 40,000 a year), each with INR and AED prices in integer minor units, yearly prices, the Medvya Assist add-on price, limits (doctors, staff, locations, Assist visits per doctor a month; empty = unlimited), trial days and the feature keys included. Version 1 is seeded from the approved price list (src/Host.Api/PublicSite/pricing.json). Console page Plans: list with prices per country, edit (a new version; existing versions never change), history; a reason on every save, platform audit log; Owner and Finance edit, Operations, Support and Reviewer read only (server-side). Then: entitlements pushed to each country's clinic database and read by the feature gate, replacing the hard-coded starter plan (StarterPlan.cs), and the owner's self-service upgrade.
Decided 15 Nov 2026 (all editable later as plan data): patients are not counted toward limits; staff beyond the included count show "Talk to us" (no seat price yet); Medvya Assist above the quota warns and never blocks; a feature not yet assigned to any plan is included in every plan; Assist is an add-on on Solo and included with its quota on Clinic and Hospital. No payment provider now (MDV-P5-065).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a plan is edited, when it is saved, then a new version exists and the earlier version is unchanged (the database refuses to change it).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a save, when it has no reason, then it is refused; with one, the reason is in the platform audit log.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an Operations, Support or Reviewer member, when they save a plan, then the API returns 403; Owner and Finance can.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a price, when it is stored, then it is integer minor units with the country's ISO currency.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a plan is edited, when it is saved, then current subscribers keep the old version until renewal.
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a price changes, when a subscriber exists, then they are notified 30 days before it applies.
- [ ] **AC7.** Given a feature is removed from a plan, when data exists, then the data stays.
- [ ] **AC8.** Given a plan version, when it is current, then the clinic's limits and feature gate in that country follow it (replaces StarterPlan.cs).

## Notes / open questions

- Delivered in slices. Console part (plans, versions, Plans page, audit, roles): PR for this ticket. Pushing entitlements to the clinic databases and replacing StarterPlan.cs wait for the per-country write path built in MDV-P5-041. The subscriber-facing criteria (keep the old version until renewal, 30 days' notice) need subscriptions (MDV-P5-043). /pricing reading the console plans is MDV-P5-050.
- Feature keys are plain strings until MDV-P5-041 adds the code feature list; then they are checked against it.
- The "Solo" plan is a one-doctor Clinic plan, not an individual account (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md, owner decision 10 Nov 2026)); revisit plan names and seat types (doctors, staff, patients) when this is built. This ticket replaces the hard-coded starter plan (1 doctor and 2 staff, patients uncapped) enforced from MDV-P1-069, and adds the owner's self-service upgrade.
- Seat counts are per organisation in total across its locations (ADR-016, MDV-P1-069); bigger chains need a bigger plan.
